name: 07_gate_fails_resets_previously_nonzero_ticks
description: [H2] System-A gate fails (weight 0.4 below threshold) so System A resets even from near-threshold; System B is DECOUPLED and arms on its own condition (current_return -1.5 <= bleed_arm -1.0).
derivation: Outer guard passes. Weight 0.4 > 0.5 is FALSE -> System-A gate fails. System A resets vwap_ticks (previously 2, near threshold) to 0 (no partial-decrement). [H2 DECOUPLING] System B independent of the System-A gate: arm -1.5 <= -1.0 TRUE -> new_vwap_bleed_ticks = 2+1 = 3; is_vwap_bleed_broken = (3 >= 3) TRUE. Returns (0, 3, False, True). Pre-H2 wrongly expected (0,0,False,False) — the bug that wiped a live bleed ladder on an unrelated System-A gate miss.
